architecture:
System: Benefits-Portal-095
Primary NIST family: Media Protection (MP); evidence focus: MP-5.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: media is sanitized or destroyed using approved procedures before disposal or reuse. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
